loading.default_pattern: Layout-matched skeletons preserve panel and table geometry.

empty.default_pattern: Plain-language message plus a concrete CTA.

error.default_pattern: Source-specific failure message plus retry or authorized fallback.

offline.default_pattern: Yellow read-only or queued-write banner; rehydration changes banner to syncing before clearing.

permission-denied.default_pattern: Explain missing permission and provide access-request CTA.

insufficient-evidence.default_pattern: Disable Approve, keep authorized Reject available, show evidence reason tooltip, and provide Refresh evidence CTA.

system_boundary_rules.allowed_data_access: Go REST API only for graph, search, enrichment, task, approval, and document data
forbidden_data_access: Direct FrankenSQLite reads or writes from browser code
Direct Zvec reads from browser code
Direct local git access from browser code
Direct GitHub gh CLI invocation from browser code
Direct FastCode invocation from browser code
Direct gmind or beads_rust CLI invocation from browser code
system_boundary_rules.graph_search_enrichment: Browser receives graph, search, and enrichment data through Go REST APIs only.

loading_rules.default: Use layout-matched skeleton loaders preserving panel/table/card geometry.
loading_rules.graph: Use skeleton graph canvas/detail panel plus progress messaging; no standalone centered spinner-only UI.
loading_rules.approval: Use multi-source evidence aggregation skeletons with progress message.

approval_rules.insufficient_evidence: Approve disabled when test logs or any required evidence stream is missing, stale, invalid, or erroring.
